name: NPC Teleporter
description: Teleporter NPCs in capitals (entry 190000) and starting zones (190001).

sql.note: upstream sets @ONY_LEVEL := 60 at line 18 and uses it in one row (line 189); the step below writes the answer into that row, so the clone stays unmodified

sql.statement: UPDATE conditions SET ConditionValue1={ony_level} WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId=15 AND SourceGroup=50004 AND SourceEntry=11 AND ConditionTypeOrReference=27;
sql.note: T104: the Onyxia portal's level requirement, the one row teleporter_capital.dist builds from @ONY_LEVEL (upstream @06e5242: `(15, @GOSSIP_MENU+4, 11, 27, @ONY_LEVEL, 3, 0, ...)` with @GOSSIP_MENU := 50000)

sql.statement: DELETE FROM creature WHERE id1 IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM creature_template WHERE entry IN (190000,190001);

prompts.question: Level needed for the Onyxia's Lair teleport (60 for classic content, 80 for WotLK)

notes: Both NPCs are always installed. Originally by Rochet2.
